credentialNote: Key loaded from .env only. No key value is stored, logged, or printed anywhere.
hardAvoidFilterNote: Episode-wide hard-prohibition terms (war/military/uniform/flag/checkpoint/border/combat/weapon/explosion/refugee/etc.) were vetoed from candidate slugs before presentation, per the approved storyboard's sensitive-content strategy. Per-slot avoid-list and semantic-action checks remain a HUMAN review gate (Playbook §8/§9/§9.1).
howToPick: Set selectionStatus to "selected" on chosen candidates (or reply with slot IDs in chat); approval triggers a separate explicit download step. downloadedAt stays null until that download happens. Nothing in this file is approved, submitted, or rendered.

slots.editorialFunction: Open the film on ordinary life as accumulation of small, unremarkable acts rather than achievement, so the thesis reads as lived texture, not aspiration.
slots.visualIntent: Hands and everyday objects at rest on an ordinary surface (a kitchen table, a work bench, tools set down): lived-in, warm, unposed, level framing, soft daylight. Presence of use, not display.
avoid: luxury interiors, new-house or real-estate glamour
currency or cash stacks as literal 'savings'
slots.searchQuery: hands everyday objects kitchen table warm natural light still
